programs.title: Bring Her Back
programs.desc: After their father's death, the siblings, Andy and Piper, are placed in Laura's care.The boy begins to suspect that the woman is hiding some secrets.It soon comes to light that their guardian is planning a dark ritual.

programs.title: Nightmare Alley
programs.desc: Times of great crisis.Stanton Carlisle (Bradley Cooper) is an ambitious and charismatic conjurer, but recently he has been plagued by bad luck in his life.One day, a man struggling with his difficult past meets an unusual couple from a traveling circus.It turns out that they both have supernatural abilities.Zeena (Toni Collette) is a clairvoyant, while her alcohol-addicted husband Pete (David Strathairn) is a former telepath.Thanks to them, Carlisle learns the secrets of human nature and begins to learn to recognize things that cannot be seen at first glance.He is trained in the art of manipulation.This knowledge opens up new opportunities for Stanton.An ambitious spiritualist, pretending to be able to read minds, intends to profit from the naivety of New York's elites.Together with the devoted Molly (Rooney Mara), he puts his plan into action.It is becoming a favorite in salons.Under the influence of a mysterious and seductive psychiatrist, Dr. Lilith Ritter (Cate Blanchett), with whom he becomes involved in an affair, he decides to defraud the financial tycoon, Ezra Grindle (Richard Jenkins).He turns out to be a dangerous opponent.Dark cinema directed by the acclaimed Guillermo del Toro.Four Oscar nominations, including Best Picture.

programs.title: Battle After Another
programs.desc: Pat (Leonardo DiCaprio) hides under a changed name as Bob Ferguson with his daughter Willa in a town in the desert.No one knows that in the past, this inconspicuous man was the leader of a group of revolutionaries that committed numerous acts of sabotage: his accomplices freed refugees, robbed banks and blew up government buildings.Sixteen years after the attack on the prison, the leader of the elusive gang is tracked down by his old enemy, Colonel Steven Lockjaw (Sean Penn), who was obsessed with Bob's beloved, Willy's mother.When the girl is kidnapped, her desperate father asks her former mentor (Benicio Del Toro) for help.Together they set off to search for the hostage.

programs.title: Queen Of Bones
programs.desc: 1930s.Teenage twins Lillian (Julia Butters) and Samuel (Jacob Tremblay) live in rural Oregon.They are half-orphans because their mother died during childbirth.The father, religious fanatic Malcolm (Martin Freeman), treats his children harshly.Ida (Taylor Schilling), who may become the teenagers' stepmother in the future, also shows no sympathy for them.Meanwhile, one day, Lillian and Samuel find a book of pagan spells in their mother's trunk.They come to the conclusion that using them will help them free themselves from the influence of adults and gain power not only over their lives, but also their surroundings.

programs.title: Clerks 2
programs.desc: After Randal and Dante's store catches fire, the friends must find another job.They still cannot come to terms with the loss of the premises, but they have no money to rebuild it.They get a job in a fast food restaurant.Soon, Dante decides to leave with his fiancée to another state.Things get complicated when it turns out that the manager of the place is pregnant.Meanwhile, Dante's bachelor party is approaching.Randall plans to organize a party whose main attraction will be a stripper.However, an unfortunate mistake occurs and things get out of control.Sequel to Kevin Smith's debut film.

programs.title: Scared Shrekless
programs.desc: Halloween is coming.This year, Shrek's favorite holiday is going to be really scary.Instead of traditional fun, refreshments and tricks, the ogre challenges his friends.Together with Fiona, Donkey, Puss in Boots and other fairy tale characters, he plans to spend the night in Lord Farquaad's haunted castle.The atmosphere of horror is to be fueled by spine-chilling stories.The one who overcomes his fear will win the competition.Biscuits, Donkey, Puss in Boots and Shrek tell dark stories... In the Polish version, the characters are voiced by famous actors, including:Zbigniew Zamachowski (Shrek) and Jerzy Stuhr (Donkey).

programs.title: Spider-Man
programs.desc: Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) is an ordinary young New Yorker.Shy, a bit clumsy, he has been secretly in love with the charming Mary Jane Watson (Kirsten Dunst) for a long time.While exploring the laboratory, he is bitten by a mutated, radioactive spider.Since then, his life changes - he becomes a superhero.He is strong, fit and enduring, and his eyesight is improving.In addition, there are extraordinary abilities - climbing walls, jumping from heights, weaving spider webs.When his beloved uncle, Ben Parker (Cliff Robertson), is murdered by a burglar, Peter decides to avenge him.Using his supernatural abilities, he begins to fight the world of evil.His main enemy soon becomes the dangerous Green Goblin (Willem Dafoe).Adaptation of a popular comic book.One of the biggest box office successes in cinema history.The film received two Oscar nominations.

programs.title: Spider-Man 2
programs.desc: Student Peter Parker as Spider-Man fights criminals threatening the inhabitants of New York.However, his private life is not going well.He's losing another job.Meanwhile, Mary Jane Watson, with whom he is in love, plans to marry someone else.Peter's relationship with his friend Harry Osborn, who cannot come to terms with his father's death, is also deteriorating.He blames Spider-Man for this tragedy.She wants to take revenge on him.To achieve his goal, he makes a deal with Doctor Otto Octavius.The scientist's actions quickly get out of control.He transforms into Doctor Octopus and kidnaps Mary Jane.Peter must transform into Spider-Man again to save not only the people of New York, but also his beloved.

actor: Doc Ock/Dr. Otto Octavius - Alfred Molina

programs.title: Spider-Man 3
programs.desc: Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) had to reconcile his feelings for Mary Jane Watson (Kirsten Dunst) with his duties as a superhero.Meanwhile, he has another difficult task ahead of him.Spider-Man merges with a symbiote from outer space that needs a large dose of adrenaline to survive.As a result of this fusion, Spider-Man's costume changes from red and blue to black.However, the character of the hero also changes.Now he is arrogant and conceited.Meanwhile, he faces his greatest enemies, Sandman (Thomas Haden Church) and Venom (Topher Grace).At the same time, he also has to face himself.A new woman also enters his life and will cause a lot of confusion in the superhero's relationship with Mary Jane (Kirsten Dunst).The third part of the adventures of Spider Man based on the comic book by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

programs.title: Quitter la nuit
programs.desc: Belgium.Emergency line operator Anna (Veerle Baetens) receives a call from a woman who has apparently made a mistake.After a while, however, he realizes that she is pretending to talk to her sister in order to confuse the driver of the car she is sitting in.When the car is soon stopped by the police, the passenger, Aly (Selma Alaoui), accuses the driver, Dary (Guillaume Duhesme), of rape.Although the man denies it, he is arrested.The investigation begins.The following weeks pass, during which law enforcement agencies look for evidence, the injured party tries to both obtain justice and return to normal life, and the suspect hopes that the case will be closed.The incident also does not allow Anna to forget about it, as it revived traumatic memories.Delphine Girard's film, which was nominated for an Oscar, is a development of the artist's short production from 2018.

programs.title: Wildcat
programs.desc: 1950s.A devout Catholic living in the American South, Flannery O'Connor (Maya Hawke), wins a writing competition.Soon he goes to New York to meet with a publisher, hoping to interest him in his novel "The Wisdom of Blood".However, they do not reach an agreement.Flannery is also dating her mentor, Robert Lowell (Philip Ettinger), with whom she has feelings.After returning home, the woman notices disturbing symptoms of illness.It turns out it was lupus, from which her father died.Flannery becomes disabled, but he can count on the care of his mother, Regina (Laura Linney), although their relationship can be strained.All the time, the young woman is struggling with an internal problem, she is afraid that her writing is contrary to her faith.Only the wise advice of Father Flynn (Liam Neeson) makes her focus on writing.This is also influenced by the information about Robert's wedding to another woman.A moving, brilliantly realized picture, inspired by the biography of the famous American short story writer and novelist.Four-time Oscar nominee Ethan Hawke was behind the camera.

programs.title: What Happens Later
programs.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.
